a-thesis.text:
Thesis: people who handle a lot of work want a dense, dark, keyboard-fast console where every state reads at a glance.

Best for heavy daily use. Feels technical for occasional users; dark is harder in bright offices.

Built from: REF-01 Linear activity trail, REF-02 Linear cards with counts, REF-04 Temporal lanes and recovery, REF-05 Inngest status table, REF-06 n8n nodes.

Sections: SEC-nav, SEC-floor, SEC-queues, SEC-list · SEC-header, SEC-facts, SEC-stations, SEC-agent, SEC-decision · SEC-ask, SEC-detail, SEC-actions

b-thesis.text:
Thesis: PSL is a design studio, so its factory should read like a calm, well-set document anyone can pick up without training.

Best for clarity and first impressions, including leadership. Shows fewer items at once.

Built from: REF-03 Linear isometric line art, REF-07 Railway mood and view switch, REF-08 Mercury split invoice counts, REF-12 Attio calm light shell.

Sections: SEC-nav, SEC-floor, SEC-queues, SEC-list · SEC-header, SEC-facts, SEC-stations, SEC-agent, SEC-decision · SEC-ask, SEC-detail, SEC-actions

c-thesis.text:
Recommended. Thesis: the stations are the product, so every screen leads with the line a piece of work travels and the separate facts it has earned.

Best for understanding where work is and why it is held. Bold structure; the track takes space on small phones.

Built from: REF-04 Temporal lanes and recovery, REF-06 n8n nodes and joins, REF-09 Ramp agent filling fields, REF-11 Devin step ticks.

Sections: SEC-nav, SEC-floor, SEC-queues, SEC-list · SEC-header, SEC-facts, SEC-stations, SEC-agent, SEC-decision · SEC-ask, SEC-detail, SEC-actions

d-thesis.text:
Thesis: work feels like a fast, quiet issue tracker. Linear's patterns (lists grouped by state, a progress circle per item, properties at the side, activity feed, ⌘K), rebuilt with PSL's own colour and content.

The progress circle fills as stations complete; orange means it needs you.

Best for people used to modern work tools. Close to concept A in feel, and it borrows another product's conventions instead of a PSL identity.

Built from: REF-01 Linear issue detail and activity, REF-02 Linear grouped cards and counts, REF-03 Linear line drawings.

Same sections as A to C.
